capabilities: Browse and filter the National Dex by type, generation, ability, stats, and traits
Switch between a sortable table and a card grid with chosen columns
Inspect evolution chains, stats, abilities, breeding data, and moves on a detail screen
Toggle Mega, Gigantamax, regional, and shiny forms
Cache fetched JSON and images per generation in IndexedDB
extras: Not on the community plugin store; install manually from a release or via BRAT. No telemetry, account, or payment; cache is per-device IndexedDB and nothing is written to the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no way to look up Pokemon data, so fans must leave the vault for a wiki or the PokeAPI site.

relations.evidence: fetches Pokemon data, sprites, and artwork from pokeapi.co

summary: Pokemon reference browser that pulls Gen 1-9 data, sprites, and artwork from PokeAPI into an Obsidian pane with filters, table/card views, and detail screens.
